site.title: Celadon · Smart mastering plugin
site.description: Celadon is a mastering plugin that runs four stages in a fixed order — BALANCE dynamic EQ, CLAY stereo clean-up, COLOR tone and glue, LIMIT true-peak limiting — while one GLAZE knob keeps listening to the song and decides how far to push as it goes. VST3 / AU on macOS (Apple silicon / Intel), VST3 on Windows x64.

nav.label: Main
nav.platforms: VST3 · AU · macOS 12+ (Apple silicon / Intel) · Windows 10 / 11 x64

footer.blurb: A personal mastering plugin — free during the early bird, with no price shown. Four stages run in a fixed order: balance → stereo clean-up → colour → limit. GLAZE keeps listening to the song and decides how far to push as it goes.
